column1: Readme version description:this readme refers to the contents of the dataset named AREA_SCIENCE_PARK_PV_Q2.
Files present in the dataset named AREA_SCIENCE_PARK_PV_Q2 are:

1.PV_Q2.csv: this CSV (comma separated value_utf-8) file contains DC side photovoltaic (PV) system parameters measured in real operating conditions from the 1st January 2013 to the 16th November 2021. The PV plant is installed over the Q2 building
column2: placed in the Basovizza campus of Area Science Park in Triest (Italy). The geographical coordinates of the PV field are: 45.64413722052132 - 13.850041741818321. Each line of the file is related to a 15 minutes period.

column4: date of the acquisition of the data (yyyymmdd)
hour expressed in hours:minutes:seconds of the acquisition of the data - 15 minutes average (hh:mm:ss)
dc tension of the first inverter to which are connected strings 1-2-3 in parallel
back side of panel temperature of one panel in the middle of one string connected to inverter 1
dc tension of the second inverter to which are connected strings 4-5-6 in parallel
back side of panel temperature of one panel in the middle of one string connected to inverter 2
dc tension of the third inverter to which are connected strings 7-8 in parallel
back side of panel temperature of one panel in the middle of one string connected to inverter 3
solar irradince measured in the plane of the panels
